title: Enforce rendered-page assertions for firstmate study page criteria
summary: Add a convention that jobs whose criteria concern what a generated study page contains must add assertions on the rendered HTML from `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, run them before handover, and treat failure as blocking. Implement the firstmate page checks as an xtask test (glossary and next-step link before first transition card, rendered model-limit findings, agent-decided transitions checked via trigger_evaluated_by), plus a fixture page that must fail. Audience: producers and the reader/verifier stages that judge study page jobs.

defaults_applied.how: New xtask test plus must-fail fixture; fmt, clippy, test pass.
Convention enforced by an xtask test rather than prose alone.
Criteria check rendered HTML behavior, not file existence.
One focused change limited to firstmate page.
Addresses missing pre-verifier render checks rather than one page fix.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Prompt token budgets prevent editing the reader prompt (3 tokens left) and verifier (2 left); the producer prompt for change has 219 tokens left, so a short rule goes there and fuller text in docs/.
Existing unit tests in xtask/src/site.rs partly cover these checks; the new integration test in xtask/tests exercises the built HTML output and adds the failing fixture.
The records/introspections file named under Files is context only and is not changed.
No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) need to change.

acceptance_criteria.text: `cargo test -p xtask` passes, including a new test that renders the real firstmate-work-handling study and asserts the glossary section and the `#next-steps` link both appear before the first transition card in the HTML.

The new test asserts exactly which model-limit findings from studies/firstmate-work-handling/model.json are present in the rendered HTML (and that others are absent), and `cargo test -p xtask` passes.
The new test asserts that every transition whose model `trigger_evaluated_by` is `agent` is rendered as agent-decided, derived from model.json rather than hard-coded, and passes.

A committed fixture page (e.g. a deliberately wrong HTML file) is run through the same assertion helpers by a test that expects failure (glossary after first card, missing link, wrong findings, wrong evaluator), proving each check can fail; `cargo test -p xtask` passes.

The convention is written in a producer prompt/brief location (crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md, within its token headroom) stating: criteria about generated page contents require HTML assertions on `cargo run -p xtask -- site` output, run before handover, and failure blocks handover. Reader prompt and other budget-tight prompts are not grown.
The convention is also recorded in a doc under docs/ (stranger-readable) naming the xtask test as its enforcing mechanism.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass with no unrelated behavior changes to site rendering.

out_of_scope: Changing the rendered page layout or study content
Editing the reader, verifier, or study prompts
Changing governance files such as athena.toml or defaults.toml
Assertions for studies other than firstmate-work-handling
departures: Slightly higher cost: needs a new integration test, fixture, and a prompt edit within tight token budgets.
urgent_reason: Cuts repeated rejected follow-up jobs by making the producer check the rendered page before the verifier sees it.
